activationEpoch.purpose: Authorize Lane 01 to implement the shared Exchange Room lens controller and canonical 16-action registry while keeping every permanent lens visible/selectable and disabling only individual unavailable action controls.

workPacket.owner: Exchange Room Phase 2 — Lens Controller + 16-Action Registry

dependencies.requiredCondition: Phase 1 implementation is merged and canonical App Hosting rollout succeeded; real-map production health evidence debt remains explicit and is not rewritten as passed.

workPacket.expectedOutput: One shared current-main Phase 2 candidate implementing a persistent lens controller and canonical sixteen-action registry. All four lenses remain visible/selectable. Only individual inactive action controls are gray/disabled and non-actionable; no unavailable-status copy is added merely to explain the disabled state.
workPacket.stopBoundary: Do not implement missing domain features, Teaming, Intelligence datasets, Resource Provider workflows, referral lifecycle expansion, messaging, notifications, billing/payments, commercial policy, tracker completion, or Independent Verification.

productOwnerDirection.marketReadyBaseline: register → organization → Exchange Room/real market → four permanent lenses/value architecture → Founding Membership → live payment → recognized paid member
productOwnerDirection.lensRule: Every permanent lens remains visible and selectable regardless of unfinished functions.
productOwnerDirection.actionRule: Only the individual function button that is not usable for the current participant/selection is gray/disabled. Preserve its normal label and do not add unavailable/coming-soon style status copy merely to explain the disabled state.
